note: Community preset library for Kenan's AutoClicker. Add yours with a pull request - see CONTRIBUTING.md.

presets.name: Spreadsheet Row Entry
presets.author: KenanSab
presets.description: Types a value then moves down a row: Enter every second. Pair it with a clipboard tool for bulk data entry.

presets.name: Slow Double-Click Assist
presets.author: KenanSab
presets.description: Double-clicks once every three seconds for users who cannot double-click quickly enough for the OS to register it.

presets.name: Idle Game Clicker
presets.author: KenanSab
presets.description: Steady 50ms clicking with slight randomisation, for single-player idle and incremental games.
